\section{What Each Node Computes: The Per-Node Dossiers}\label{sec:rnode-dossiers}

Every number, rung and pointer below is generated from the registries named in
the file header; nothing in this section is typed by hand. \textbf{The
numbering is the catalogue numbering of \texttt{control-stages.edn}}, which
is read off the drawn control map, and not the older contract numbering the two
schemes diverge on.

The readiness scale is ordered (named $\to$ type-transcribed $\to$ formula-transcribed $\to$ witnessed $\to$ constructed $\to$ wired $\to$ validated $\to$ run-correlated) and no
rung is skippable. Three rungs are derivable from these registries and only three: a
node is \textsc{named} because the roster declares it, \textsc{type-transcribed}
because an equation it runs names a Lean declaration in the checked union
and found in its pinned owning module, and \textsc{formula-transcribed} because
the rung below is licensed and the registry carries the formal line. Everything
above that needs an evidence type these registries do not carry. A node whose
required construction has no inhabitant in the fundamentals census is
\emph{capped}: transcription cannot climb past an uninhabited constructor.
Each rung prints the pointer that licenses it, and the generator resolves every
one of those pointers --- file present, line inside the file --- before writing
this file; a rung claim it cannot resolve stops the build rather than printing.

Each node also carries the rung of every Lean declaration its equations bind,
read from the per-declaration accounting rather than restated here. The scale is
the same eight rungs in both places and that is checked, not assumed: if the
accounting's rung vocabulary and this section's differ by one element, nothing
renders. The two say different things about the same node --- a node reaches
\textsc{formula-transcribed} because an equation at it carries a formal line,
while a declaration reaches it because a check elaborates its defining
expression --- and reading them side by side is how a node whose registry entry
outruns its declarations becomes visible.

\textbf{1 of 20 nodes at their obligated state;
19 short: R2, R8, R1, R3, R3a, R7, R5, R6, R13, R14, R15, R11, R16, R10, R12, R20, R17, TRACE, R9.}
Equation-bearing nodes have the full AIF ladder as their obligation, limited by
any FUNDAMENTALS cap. Plumbing has named as its terminal formal rung, but its
obligated state also requires all seven node-linked lifecycle cells to exist.
Reaching a capped rung does not inhabit the missing construction or establish
runtime validity; the remaining construction debts are listed below.

6 required constructions are uninhabited in the fundamentals
census. The join is by Lean declaration name and by nothing else, because
\texttt{FUNDAMENTALS.edn} carries no node field: it places 1 of them
at a node and leaves 5 at no node (\texttt{fundamental/belief-to-state-distribution}, \texttt{fundamental/controlled-transition-kernel}, \texttt{fundamental/policy-conditioned-state-predictive}, \texttt{fundamental/machine-preference-distribution}, \texttt{fundamental/parameter-kernels}). Placing
those by hand is exactly the judgement this section is built not to make.

The seven lifecycle positions, in order, are commissioned, dispatched, parked, returned, checked, recorded, surfaced.
Legend: \texttt{+} exists (code checks or records the cell),
\texttt{o} named-only (conduct named without a running check or record),
\texttt{-} absent;
\texttt{.......} means outside the census scope (not censused).
Absent means no NODE-LINKED implementation: generic Agency machinery exists
uncredited in \texttt{ALIGN-rnode-process-census.md}. Closing that join is the
census's separate candidate repair, not an effect of this presentation.
